svg.text: Entity-set attention + spatial CNN + finite-window causal Transformer
Structured game observations, not image pixels
Entity padding mask + learned null entity
One token per time step; shared frame-encoder weights
Finite causal window, not Transformer-XL recurrence or persistent KV memory.
Bomb head retained; current run starts with 0 bombs.
Solid arrows: policy/value forward path. Dashed branches: auxiliary supervision or critic-only geometry input.
Geometry labels and fire_distance are not direct actor inputs. PPO updates the shared encoder and temporal backbone.
Source: transformer_policy.py · transformer_obs.py · train_abplus.py · EXPERIMENTS.md (C37). Diagram is code-derived; no model changes.
